::: {#thm-bias-sq-plus-var}
#### Expanded squared bias plus variance

For any one-dimensional estimator $\hparam$ of an estimand $\param$,
the squared bias plus the variance is:

$$\sqf{\bias{\hparam}} + \var{\hparam} = \E{\hparam^2} - 2\E{\hparam}\param + \param^2$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-bias-sq-plus-var, worked in @sol-bias-sq-plus-var.
It adds the variance to the squared bias of @thm-sq-bias-expand.

:::
